# 日历

团队日历的周视图，用自己的网格绘制：时间刻度与七个日期列以细线分隔，事件是按所属日历着色的浅色块并带实色前缘，重叠的事件并排显示，有全天事件行、着色的周末、高亮的今天与当前时间线。侧栏有一个由日期按钮组成的月历、以复选框显示的日历列表与下一个事件。点击空白时段打开预填该时间的 Modal 与 Form；点击事件打开 Popover 显示详情，可以编辑，或经危险确认后删除。T、N、J、K、D、W 是键盘快捷键。

**难度**：场景　**用到的组件**：[Avatar](../components/Avatar.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [Checkbox](../components/Checkbox.md), [DatePicker](../components/DatePicker.md), [Form](../components/Form.md), [Grid](../components/Grid.md), [Heading](../components/Heading.md), [Icon](../components/Icon.md), [IconButton](../components/IconButton.md), [Inline](../components/Inline.md), [Input](../components/Input.md), [Modal](../components/Modal.md), [Popover](../components/Popover.md), [Segmented](../components/Segmented.md), [Select](../components/Select.md), [Stack](../components/Stack.md), [Text](../components/Text.md), [TimePicker](../components/TimePicker.md), [useConfirmDanger](../components/useConfirmDanger.md), [useHotkeys](../components/useHotkeys.md), [useMessage](../components/useMessage.md)

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  Avatar,
  Button,
  Checkbox,
  DatePicker,
  Form,
  Grid,
  Heading,
  Icon,
  IconButton,
  Inline,
  Input,
  Modal,
  Popover,
  Segmented,
  Select,
  Stack,
  Text,
  TimePicker,
  useConfirmDanger,
  useHotkeys,
  useMessage,
} from 'vellum-ui'
import styles from './CalendarWeek.module.css'

type CalendarId = 'product' | 'design' | 'engineering' | 'marketing' | 'personal' | 'away'

interface Calendar {
  readonly id: CalendarId
  readonly name: string
  /** A color of the chart palette, as its number: the CSS turns `data-calendar-tone="3"` into `--vl-color-chart-3`. */
  readonly tone: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 7
}

const CALENDARS: readonly Calendar[] = [
  { id: 'product', name: 'Product', tone: 1 },
  { id: 'design', name: 'Design', tone: 7 },
  { id: 'engineering', name: 'Engineering', tone: 3 },
  { id: 'marketing', name: 'Marketing', tone: 2 },
  { id: 'personal', name: 'Personal', tone: 5 },
  { id: 'away', name: 'Out of office', tone: 4 },
]

const calendarOf = (id: CalendarId) =>
  CALENDARS.find((c) => c.id === id) ?? (CALENDARS[0] as Calendar)

const PEOPLE = ['Alex Morgan', 'Riley Chen', 'Sam Lee', 'Jordan Park', 'Taylor Kim', 'Casey Wong']

interface CalEvent {
  readonly id: string
  readonly title: string
  readonly calendar: CalendarId
  /** The (first) day, as an ISO date such as `2026-11-13`. */
  readonly date: string
  /** Start and end as `HH:mm`; empty for all-day events. */
  readonly start: string
  readonly end: string
  /** Number of days of an all-day event; 0 for an event with times. */
  readonly days: number
  readonly location: string
  readonly guests: readonly string[]
}

type Seed = readonly [number, string, string, string, CalendarId, string?]

const SEEDS: readonly Seed[] = [
  [-7, '10:00', '11:00', 'Roadmap review', 'product', 'Room 4'],
  [-5, '14:00', '15:30', 'Design critique', 'design', 'Studio'],
  [0, '', '2', 'Taylor out of office', 'away'],
  [0, '10:00', '11:00', 'Roadmap review', 'product', 'Room 4'],
  [0, '13:00', '14:30', 'Design critique', 'design', 'Studio'],
  [0, '13:30', '14:00', '1:1 with Riley', 'personal'],
  [0, '16:00', '17:00', 'Campaign kickoff', 'marketing', 'Video call'],
  [1, '08:00', '09:00', 'Gym', 'personal'],
  [1, '11:00', '12:00', 'Sprint planning', 'engineering', 'Room 2'],
  [1, '11:30', '12:30', 'Customer call: Northwind', 'product', 'Video call'],
  [1, '14:00', '15:30', 'Onboarding flows workshop', 'design', 'Studio'],
  [1, '15:00', '16:00', 'Launch copy review', 'marketing'],
  [2, '', '2', 'Design offsite', 'design', 'Lakeside lodge'],
  [2, '10:00', '12:00', 'Architecture review', 'engineering', 'Room 2'],
  [2, '12:30', '13:30', 'Lunch with Sam', 'personal', 'Noodle bar'],
  [2, '15:00', '15:30', 'Pricing sync', 'product'],
  [3, '09:00', '10:30', 'Usability tests', 'design', 'Lab'],
  [3, '10:00', '11:00', 'API deprecation plan', 'engineering'],
  [3, '14:00', '15:00', 'Quarterly business review', 'product', 'Board room'],
  [3, '17:00', '18:00', 'Dentist', 'personal'],
  [4, '', '1', 'Release 4.2 ships', 'product'],
  [4, '10:00', '11:00', 'Release go / no-go', 'engineering', 'Room 2'],
  [4, '11:30', '12:15', 'Interview: senior designer', 'design', 'Video call'],
  [4, '14:00', '15:00', 'Launch retro', 'product', 'Room 4'],
  [4, '15:30', '17:00', 'Focus time', 'personal'],
  [4, '16:00', '16:30', 'Weekly metrics', 'marketing'],
  [4, '17:30', '18:30', 'Team drinks', 'personal', 'The Anchor'],
  [5, '10:00', '12:00', 'Farmers market', 'personal'],
  [6, '18:00', '18:30', 'Plan the week', 'personal'],
  [7, '10:00', '11:00', 'Roadmap review', 'product', 'Room 4'],
  [8, '', '3', 'Riley out of office', 'away'],
  [9, '13:00', '14:30', 'Design critique', 'design', 'Studio'],
]

function seedEvents(monday: string): CalEvent[] {
  const event = ([day, start, end, title, calendar, location = '']: Seed, i: number): CalEvent => ({
    id: `e${i}`,
    title,
    calendar,
    date: addDays(monday, day),
    start,
    end: start ? end : '',
    days: start ? 0 : Number(end),
    location,
    guests: PEOPLE.slice(i % 4, (i % 4) + 1 + (i % 3)),
  })
  const standups = [-7, 0, 7].flatMap((week) =>
    [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((d): Seed => [week + d, '09:30', '09:45', 'Stand-up', 'engineering']),
  )
  return [...SEEDS, ...standups].map(event)
}

const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0')

const isoDay = (d: Date) => `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`

const parseDay = (iso: string) => new Date(`${iso}T00:00`)

const addDays = (iso: string, n: number) => {
  const d = parseDay(iso)
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + n)
  return isoDay(d)
}

const mondayOf = (iso: string) => addDays(iso, -((parseDay(iso).getDay() + 6) % 7))

const toMin = (time: string) => Number(time.slice(0, 2)) * 60 + Number(time.slice(3, 5))

const hhmm = (min: number) => `${pad(Math.floor(min / 60))}:${pad(min % 60)}`

const fmt = (options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => {
  const f = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', options)
  return (iso: string) => f.format(parseDay(iso))
}

const weekday = fmt({ weekday: 'short' })

const longDay = fmt({ weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' })

const shortDay = fmt({ month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })

const monthYear = fmt({ month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })

function weekNumber(iso: string) {
  const thursday = parseDay(addDays(mondayOf(iso), 3))
  const jan1 = new Date(thursday.getFullYear(), 0, 1)
  return Math.floor(Math.round((thursday.getTime() - jan1.getTime()) / 86_400_000) / 7) + 1
}

const HOURS = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, h) => h)

const FIRST_HOUR = 7

const WEEKDAYS = ['Mo', 'Tu', 'We', 'Th', 'Fr', 'Sa', 'Su']

const bandEdge = (before: boolean, after: boolean) =>
  before && after ? 'middle' : before ? 'end' : after ? 'start' : 'single'

interface Placed {
  readonly event: CalEvent
  /** The column of the event among those it overlaps (0-based), and their number (at most 3). */
  readonly lane: number
  readonly lanes: number
}

function layoutDay(events: readonly CalEvent[]): Placed[] {
  const sorted = [...events].sort(
    (a, b) => a.start.localeCompare(b.start) || b.end.localeCompare(a.end),
  )
  const placed: Placed[] = []
  let cluster: { event: CalEvent; lane: number }[] = []
  let laneEnds: string[] = []
  const flush = () => {
    for (const c of cluster) placed.push({ ...c, lanes: Math.min(3, laneEnds.length) })
    cluster = []
    laneEnds = []
  }
  for (const event of sorted) {
    if (laneEnds.every((end) => end <= event.start)) flush()
    let lane = laneEnds.findIndex((end) => end <= event.start)
    if (lane < 0) lane = laneEnds.push(event.end) - 1
    else laneEnds[lane] = event.end
    cluster.push({ event, lane: Math.min(2, lane) })
  }
  flush()
  return placed
}

const offset = (startMin: number) => {
  const minute = startMin % 60
  return {
    'data-at': minute - (minute % 15) || undefined,
    'data-fine': minute % 15 >= 5 ? (minute % 15) - (minute % 5) : undefined,
  }
}

const span = (lengthMin: number) => {
  const quarters = Math.max(1, Math.round(lengthMin / 15))
  return {
    'data-hours': Math.min(6, Math.floor(quarters / 4)) || undefined,
    'data-quarters': quarters % 4 || undefined,
  }
}

interface EventValues {
  readonly title: string
  readonly calendar: CalendarId
  readonly date: string
  readonly start: string
  readonly end: string
  readonly guests: string[]
  readonly location: string
}

interface Draft {
  /** The event that is edited; null for a new one. */
  readonly id: string | null
  readonly days: number
  readonly values: EventValues
  /** Remounts the form with these values each time the dialog opens. */
  readonly key: number
}

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

function EventDetails(props: {
  readonly event: CalEvent
  readonly onEdit: () => void
  readonly onDelete: () => void
}) {
  const { event } = props
  const calendar = calendarOf(event.calendar)
  const when =
    event.days > 0
      ? `${longDay(event.date)}${event.days > 1 ? ` – ${shortDay(addDays(event.date, event.days - 1))}` : ''}, all day`
      : `${longDay(event.date)}, ${event.start} – ${event.end}`
  return (
    <div className={styles.details} data-calendar-tone={calendar.tone}>
      <Stack gap={4}>
        <div className={styles.detailsHead}>
          <span className={styles.swatch} />
          <Stack gap={1}>
            <Heading level={3}>{event.title}</Heading>
            <Text size="sm" tone="secondary" numeric>
              {when}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </div>
        <Stack gap={2}>
          <Inline gap={2}>
            <Icon name="calendar" tone="tertiary" />
            <Text size="sm">{calendar.name}</Text>
          </Inline>
          {event.location && (
            <Inline gap={2}>
              <Icon name="pin" tone="tertiary" />
              <Text size="sm">{event.location}</Text>
            </Inline>
          )}
          {event.guests.length > 0 && (
            <Inline gap={2} align="start">
              <Icon name="users" tone="tertiary" />
              <Stack gap={1}>
                {event.guests.map((g) => (
                  <Inline key={g} gap={2}>
                    <Avatar name={g} size={20} />
                    <Text size="sm">{g}</Text>
                  </Inline>
                ))}
              </Stack>
            </Inline>
          )}
        </Stack>
        <Inline gap={2} justify="end">
          <Button size="sm" variant="text" tone="danger" icon="trash" onClick={props.onDelete}>
            Delete
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" icon="edit" onClick={props.onEdit}>
            Edit
          </Button>
        </Inline>
      </Stack>
    </div>
  )
}

export function CalendarWeek() {
  const message = useMessage()
  const confirm = useConfirmDanger()
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => new Date())
  const today = isoDay(now)
  const nowMin = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes()
  const [events, setEvents] = useState(() => seedEvents(mondayOf(isoDay(new Date()))))
  const [anchor, setAnchor] = useState(today)
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => today.slice(0, 8).concat('01'))
  const [view, setView] = useState<'day' | 'week'>('week')
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState<readonly CalendarId[]>(CALENDARS.map((c) => c.id))
  const [sidebar, setSidebar] = useState<'auto' | 'open' | 'closed'>('auto')
  const [openKey, setOpenKey] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft | null>(null)
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false)
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
  const [form] = Form.useForm<EventValues>()
  const boardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const headRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const firstHourRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const sidebarRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)

  // The current-time line moves every half minute
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 30_000)
    return () => clearInterval(timer)
  }, [])

  // Open at the start of the working day, just below the sticky day headers
  useEffect(() => {
    const board = boardRef.current
    const hour = firstHourRef.current
    if (!board || !hour || !headRef.current) return
    const top = hour.getBoundingClientRect().top - board.getBoundingClientRect().top
    board.scrollTop = top - headRef.current.offsetHeight - hour.offsetHeight / 3
  }, [])

  const monday = mondayOf(anchor)
  const days = view === 'week' ? Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(monday, i)) : [anchor]
  const shown = events.filter((e) => visible.includes(e.calendar))
  const allDayOn = (day: string) =>
    shown.filter((e) => e.days > 0 && e.date <= day && day <= addDays(e.date, e.days - 1))
  const timedOn = (day: string) => shown.filter((e) => e.days === 0 && e.date === day)

  /** Moves to a day, and the mini month with it. */
  const goTo = (iso: string) => {
    setAnchor(iso)
    setMonth(`${iso.slice(0, 8)}01`)
  }
  const step = (direction: 1 | -1) => goTo(addDays(anchor, direction * (view === 'week' ? 7 : 1)))

  const openDialog = (id: string | null, days: number, values: EventValues) => {
    setOpenKey(null)
    setDraft({ id, days, values, key: Date.now() })
    setDialogOpen(true)
  }
  const closeDialog = () => {
    form.resetFields()
    setDialogOpen(false)
  }

  /** A new event at a time, by default the next full hour today or 09:00 on another day. */
  const create = (
    date = anchor,
    startMin = date === today ? Math.min(23, now.getHours() + 1) * 60 : 540,
  ) =>
    openDialog(null, 0, {
      title: '',
      calendar: visible[0] ?? 'product',
      date,
      start: hhmm(startMin),
      end: hhmm(Math.min(startMin + 60, 24 * 60 - 15)),
      guests: [],
      location: '',
    })

  const edit = (e: CalEvent) => openDialog(e.id, e.days, { ...e, guests: [...e.guests] })

  const save = async (v: EventValues) => {
    if (!draft) return
    setSaving(true)
    await wait(600)
    const saved: CalEvent = {
      id: draft.id ?? `e${Date.now()}`,
      title: v.title.trim(),
      calendar: v.calendar,
      date: v.date,
      start: draft.days ? '' : v.start,
      end: draft.days ? '' : v.end,
      days: draft.days,
      location: (v.location ?? '').trim(),
      guests: v.guests ?? [],
    }
    setEvents((list) =>
      draft.id ? list.map((e) => (e.id === draft.id ? saved : e)) : [...list, saved],
    )
    setVisible((list) => (list.includes(saved.calendar) ? list : [...list, saved.calendar]))
    setSaving(false)
    closeDialog()
    goTo(saved.date)
    message.success(
      draft.id ? 'Changes saved' : `"${saved.title}" added to ${shortDay(saved.date)}`,
    )
  }

  const remove = async (e: CalEvent) => {
    setOpenKey(null)
    const ok = await confirm({
      title: 'Delete event',
      description: `"${e.title}" is removed from the calendars of its ${e.guests.length} guests, who get a cancellation.`,
      okText: 'Delete',
    })
    if (!ok) return
    setEvents((list) => list.filter((x) => x.id !== e.id))
    message.success(`Deleted "${e.title}"`)
  }

  const toggleSidebar = () =>
    // Whether the sidebar shows by default depends on the width (a container query): ask the element
    setSidebar((sidebarRef.current?.offsetWidth ?? 0) > 0 ? 'closed' : 'open')

  const idle = !dialogOpen
  useHotkeys('t', () => goTo(today), { description: 'Go to today', enabled: idle })
  useHotkeys('n', () => create(), { description: 'New event', enabled: idle })
  useHotkeys('j', () => step(1), { description: 'Next week or day', enabled: idle })
  useHotkeys('k', () => step(-1), { description: 'Previous week or day', enabled: idle })
  useHotkeys('d', () => setView('day'), { description: 'Day view', enabled: idle })
  useHotkeys('w', () => setView('week'), { description: 'Week view', enabled: idle })

  /** An event block in the grid, or a chip in the all-day row, with its details in a Popover. */
  const renderEvent = (e: CalEvent, day: string, placed?: Placed) => {
    const key = `${e.id}@${day}`
    const start = toMin(e.start)
    const length = toMin(e.end) - start
    const past = day < today || (day === today && placed !== undefined && toMin(e.end) <= nowMin)
    const last = addDays(e.date, e.days - 1)
    return (
      <Popover
        key={key}
        trigger="click"
        placement={placed ? 'right' : 'bottom'}
        open={openKey === key}
        onOpenChange={(open) => setOpenKey(open ? key : null)}
        content={<EventDetails event={e} onEdit={() => edit(e)} onDelete={() => remove(e)} />}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className={placed ? styles.event : styles.chip}
          data-vl-state=""
          data-calendar-tone={calendarOf(e.calendar).tone}
          data-selected={openKey === key || undefined}
          data-past={past || undefined}
          {...(placed && { ...offset(start), ...span(length) })}
          data-lane={placed?.lane || undefined}
          data-lanes={placed && placed.lanes > 1 ? placed.lanes : undefined}
          data-short={(placed && length <= 30) || undefined}
          data-continues-before={(!placed && day > e.date) || undefined}
          data-continues-after={(!placed && day < last) || undefined}
        >
          <span className={styles.eventTitle}>{e.title}</span>
          {placed && (
            <span className={styles.eventTime}>
              {length <= 30 ? e.start : `${e.start} – ${e.end}`}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>
      </Popover>
    )
  }

  const nowLine = days.includes(today)
  const nowPosition = offset(nowMin)
  const next = timedOn(today)
    .filter((e) => toMin(e.end) > nowMin)
    .sort((a, b) => a.start.localeCompare(b.start))[0]
  const inRange = (d: string) => (view === 'week' ? mondayOf(d) === monday : d === anchor)
  const monthStart = mondayOf(month)
  const monthDays = Array.from({ length: 42 }, (_, i) => addDays(monthStart, i))
  const lastDay = days[days.length - 1] ?? anchor
  const title =
    monday.slice(0, 7) === lastDay.slice(0, 7) || view === 'day'
      ? monthYear(anchor)
      : `${monthYear(monday).split(' ')[0]} – ${monthYear(lastDay)}`

  return (
    <div className={styles.calendar} data-sidebar={sidebar}>
      <aside className={styles.sidebar} ref={sidebarRef} aria-label="Calendars">
        {/* The mini month: a grid of day buttons; the days of the view form a band */}
        <Stack gap={2}>
          <Inline justify="between">
            <Text weight="semibold">{monthYear(month)}</Text>
            <Inline gap={0}>
              <IconButton
                size="sm"
                icon="chevron-left"
                label="Previous month"
                onClick={() => setMonth(addDays(month, -1).slice(0, 8).concat('01'))}
              />
              <IconButton
                size="sm"
                icon="chevron-right"
                label="Next month"
                onClick={() => setMonth(addDays(month, 31).slice(0, 8).concat('01'))}
              />
            </Inline>
          </Inline>
          <div className={styles.miniGrid}>
            {WEEKDAYS.map((w) => (
              <span key={w} className={styles.miniWeekday} aria-hidden="true">
                {w}
              </span>
            ))}
            {monthDays.map((d, i) => {
              const range = inRange(d)
              return (
                <button
                  key={d}
                  type="button"
                  className={styles.miniDay}
                  data-vl-state=""
                  aria-label={longDay(d)}
                  aria-current={d === today ? 'date' : undefined}
                  data-out={d.slice(0, 7) !== month.slice(0, 7) || undefined}
                  data-today={d === today || undefined}
                  data-busy={shown.some((e) => e.date === d) || undefined}
                  data-range={
                    range
                      ? bandEdge(
                          inRange(addDays(d, -1)) && i % 7 > 0,
                          inRange(addDays(d, 1)) && i % 7 < 6,
                        )
                      : undefined
                  }
                  onClick={() => goTo(d)}
                >
                  <span className={styles.miniNum}>{Number(d.slice(8))}</span>
                </button>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </Stack>

        <Stack gap={2}>
          <Text overline>My calendars</Text>
          {CALENDARS.map((c) => (
            <Inline key={c.id} justify="between">
              <Checkbox
                checked={visible.includes(c.id)}
                onChange={(on) =>
                  setVisible((list) => (on ? [...list, c.id] : list.filter((id) => id !== c.id)))
                }
              >
                <span className={styles.calendarName} data-calendar-tone={c.tone}>
                  <span className={styles.swatch} />
                  {c.name}
                </span>
              </Checkbox>
              <Text size="xs" tone="tertiary" numeric>
                {events.filter((e) => e.calendar === c.id && mondayOf(e.date) === monday).length}
              </Text>
            </Inline>
          ))}
        </Stack>

        {next && (
          <div className={styles.upNext} data-calendar-tone={calendarOf(next.calendar).tone}>
            <Text size="xs" overline>
              {toMin(next.start) <= nowMin
                ? 'Happening now'
                : `Up next, in ${toMin(next.start) - nowMin} min`}
            </Text>
            <Text weight="semibold" truncate>
              {next.title}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" tone="secondary" numeric>
              {next.start} – {next.end}
              {next.location && `, ${next.location}`}
            </Text>
          </div>
        )}
      </aside>

      <main className={styles.main}>
        <header className={styles.toolbar}>
          <IconButton icon="sidebar" label="Show or hide the sidebar" onClick={toggleSidebar} />
          <Button onClick={() => goTo(today)}>Today</Button>
          <Inline gap={0}>
            <IconButton
              icon="chevron-left"
              label={`Previous ${view} (K)`}
              onClick={() => step(-1)}
            />
            <IconButton icon="chevron-right" label={`Next ${view} (J)`} onClick={() => step(1)} />
          </Inline>
          <Inline gap={3} align="baseline" wrap grow>
            <Heading level={1}>{title}</Heading>
            <Text tone="secondary" numeric>
              {view === 'week'
                ? `${shortDay(monday)} – ${shortDay(lastDay)}, week ${weekNumber(monday)}`
                : weekday(anchor)}
            </Text>
          </Inline>
          <Segmented
            value={view}
            onChange={setView}
            options={[
              { value: 'day', label: 'Day' },
              { value: 'week', label: 'Week' },
            ]}
          />
          <Button variant="primary" icon="plus" onClick={() => create()}>
            New event
          </Button>
        </header>

        {/* One scroll container: the day headers stick to the top, the time gutter to the start */}
        <div className={styles.board} ref={boardRef} data-view={view}>
          <div className={styles.head} ref={headRef}>
            <div className={styles.corner} />
            {days.map((d) => (
              <button
                key={d}
                type="button"
                className={styles.dayHead}
                data-vl-state=""
                data-today={d === today || undefined}
                aria-label={`${longDay(d)}, show the day`}
                onClick={() => {
                  goTo(d)
                  setView('day')
                }}
              >
                <span className={styles.weekday}>{weekday(d)}</span>
                <span className={styles.dayNumber}>{Number(d.slice(8))}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
            <div className={styles.corner}>
              <Text size="2xs" tone="tertiary">
                All day
              </Text>
            </div>
            {days.map((d) => (
              <div
                key={d}
                className={styles.allDay}
                data-weekend={parseDay(d).getDay() % 6 === 0 || undefined}
              >
                {allDayOn(d).map((e) => renderEvent(e, d))}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className={styles.body}>
            <div className={styles.gutter} aria-hidden="true">
              {HOURS.map((h) => (
                <div
                  key={h}
                  className={styles.hour}
                  ref={h === FIRST_HOUR ? firstHourRef : undefined}
                >
                  {h > 0 && <span className={styles.hourLabel}>{hhmm(h * 60)}</span>}
                  {nowLine && h === now.getHours() && (
                    <span className={styles.nowLabel} {...nowPosition}>
                      {hhmm(nowMin)}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {days.map((d) => {
              const placed = layoutDay(timedOn(d))
              return (
                <div
                  key={d}
                  className={styles.day}
                  data-weekend={parseDay(d).getDay() % 6 === 0 || undefined}
                  data-today={d === today || undefined}
                >
                  {HOURS.map((h) => (
                    <div key={h} className={styles.hour}>
                      {/* Empty half hours create an event there; the keyboard path is "New event" */}
                      {[0, 30].map((m) => (
                        <button
                          key={m}
                          type="button"
                          tabIndex={-1}
                          className={styles.slot}
                          data-vl-state=""
                          aria-label={`New event on ${longDay(d)} at ${hhmm(h * 60 + m)}`}
                          onClick={() => create(d, h * 60 + m)}
                        />
                      ))}
                      {placed
                        .filter((p) => Math.floor(toMin(p.event.start) / 60) === h)
                        .map((p) => renderEvent(p.event, d, p))}
                      {d === today && h === now.getHours() && (
                        <span className={styles.now} {...nowPosition} />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>

      <Modal
        title={draft?.id ? 'Edit event' : 'New event'}
        open={dialogOpen}
        okText={draft?.id ? 'Save' : 'Create'}
        okLoading={saving}
        onOk={() => form.submit()}
        onCancel={closeDialog}
      >
        {draft && (
          <Form
            key={draft.key}
            form={form}
            initialValues={draft.values}
            onFinish={save}
            disabled={saving}
          >
            <Form.Item
              label="Title"
              name="title"
              rules={[{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: 'Give the event a title' }]}
            >
              <Input autoFocus placeholder="For example: Design review" />
            </Form.Item>
            <Form.Item label="Calendar" name="calendar">
              <Select
                options={CALENDARS.map((c) => ({
                  value: c.id,
                  label: (
                    <span className={styles.calendarName} data-calendar-tone={c.tone}>
                      <span className={styles.swatch} />
                      {c.name}
                    </span>
                  ),
                }))}
              />
            </Form.Item>
            <Grid columns={draft.days > 0 ? 1 : 3} gap={3}>
              <Form.Item
                label={draft.days > 1 ? 'First day' : 'Day'}
                name="date"
                rules={[{ required: true }]}
              >
                <DatePicker allowClear={false} />
              </Form.Item>
              {draft.days === 0 && (
                <>
                  <Form.Item label="Start" name="start" rules={[{ required: true }]}>
                    <TimePicker format="HH:mm" minuteStep={15} allowClear={false} />
                  </Form.Item>
                  <Form.Item
                    label="End"
                    name="end"
                    rules={[
                      { required: true },
                      {
                        validator: (value) =>
                          typeof value === 'string' && value <= String(form.getFieldValue('start'))
                            ? 'Ends before it starts'
                            : undefined,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <TimePicker format="HH:mm" minuteStep={15} allowClear={false} />
                  </Form.Item>
                </>
              )}
            </Grid>
            <Form.Item label="Guests" name="guests">
              <Select
                multiple
                showSearch
                placeholder="Add people"
                options={PEOPLE.map((p) => ({ value: p, label: p }))}
              />
            </Form.Item>
            <Form.Item label="Location" name="location">
              <Input placeholder="A room, an address or a video link" />
            </Form.Item>
          </Form>
        )}
      </Modal>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```css
/*
 * Calendar: the week grid of a team calendar. Every value is a token (var(--vl-...)), a relative unit or
 * 0 / 1px, so the grid follows the color mode, the accent color and the density. Clickable elements are native
 * buttons with data-vl-state for hover, press and focus; ::before is left to the library.
 *
 * Tints mix a token into another with color-mix(in oklab, ...): neutral tokens have no real hue, and oklch would
 * pull the mix towards a hue of 0 (pink).
 */

.calendar {
  /* The height of one hour follows the control height, so the grid is denser in the compact density */
  --hour: calc(var(--vl-control-height-md) * 1.5);
  --gutter: var(--vl-space-8);
  --column-min: calc(var(--vl-space-8) * 1.5);
  --edge: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 3);
  container: calendar / inline-size;
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: calc(var(--vl-space-8) * 9);
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-2xl);
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
  box-shadow:
    var(--vl-shadow-near),
    inset 0 0 0 1px var(--vl-color-border);
  /* biome-ignore lint/correctness/noUnknownFunction: global() references keyframes outside the CSS Module */
  animation: global(vl-rise) var(--vl-motion-duration-slow) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard) both;
}

/* The color of each calendar, chosen in the markup with data-calendar-tone: a chart color and the text color on it */
.calendar [data-calendar-tone="1"],
.details[data-calendar-tone="1"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-1);
  --tone-on: var(--vl-color-chart-1-on);
}
.calendar [data-calendar-tone="2"],
.details[data-calendar-tone="2"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-2);
  --tone-on: var(--vl-color-chart-2-on);
}
.calendar [data-calendar-tone="3"],
.details[data-calendar-tone="3"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-3);
  --tone-on: var(--vl-color-chart-3-on);
}
.calendar [data-calendar-tone="4"],
.details[data-calendar-tone="4"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-4);
  --tone-on: var(--vl-color-chart-4-on);
}
.calendar [data-calendar-tone="5"],
.details[data-calendar-tone="5"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-5);
  --tone-on: var(--vl-color-chart-5-on);
}
.calendar [data-calendar-tone="7"],
.details[data-calendar-tone="7"] {
  --tone: var(--vl-color-chart-7);
  --tone-on: var(--vl-color-chart-7-on);
}

/* —— Sidebar: on the canvas color, so the grid stands out as the working surface —— */

.sidebar {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-6);
  width: calc(var(--vl-grid-column-md) + var(--vl-space-5));
  padding: var(--vl-space-4);
  overflow-y: auto;
  border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-canvas);
}

.calendar[data-sidebar="closed"] .sidebar {
  display: none;
}

/* Narrow: hidden unless asked for, and then over the grid like a sheet */
@container calendar (width < 62em) {
  .sidebar {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block: 0;
    inset-inline-start: 0;
    z-index: 4;
    box-shadow: var(--vl-shadow-float);
  }
  .calendar:not([data-sidebar="open"]) .sidebar {
    display: none;
  }
}

.miniHead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-inline-start: var(--vl-space-1);
  margin-block-end: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.miniGrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
  row-gap: 1px;
}

.miniWeekday {
  padding-block: var(--vl-space-1);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xs);
  text-align: center;
}

.miniDay {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.miniDay[data-out] {
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
}

/* The days of the view form one band with rounded ends */
.miniDay[data-range] {
  background: var(--vl-color-fill-selected);
}
.miniDay[data-range="middle"] {
  border-radius: 0;
}
.miniDay[data-range="start"] {
  border-start-end-radius: 0;
  border-end-end-radius: 0;
}
.miniDay[data-range="end"] {
  border-start-start-radius: 0;
  border-end-start-radius: 0;
}

.miniNum {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 80%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
}

.miniDay[data-today] .miniNum {
  background: var(--vl-color-accent-fill);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-on-accent);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
}

/* A dot under the days that have events */
.miniDay[data-busy]::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-end: 6%;
  width: var(--edge);
  height: var(--edge);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
}

.calendarRow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.calendarName {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.swatch {
  flex: none;
  width: calc(var(--vl-space-2) + var(--vl-border-width) * 2);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: calc(var(--vl-radius-sm) / 2);
  background: var(--tone);
}

.upNext {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  margin-block-start: auto;
  padding: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-4);
  border-inline-start: var(--edge) solid var(--tone);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-lg);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 10%, var(--vl-color-bg-surface));
}

/* —— Toolbar —— */

.main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 0;
}

.toolbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-3);
  padding: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-4);
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
}

.title {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0 var(--vl-space-3);
  min-width: 0;
  margin-inline: var(--vl-space-2) auto;
}

/* —— The grid: a gutter and one column per day, sharing one template in the header and the body —— */

.board {
  --days: 7;
  --columns: var(--gutter) repeat(var(--days), minmax(var(--column-min), 1fr));
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: auto;
}

.board[data-view="day"] {
  --days: 1;
}

.head,
.body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--columns);
}

.head {
  position: sticky;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
}

/* The gutter and the corners stay in place when a narrow grid scrolls sideways */
.corner,
.gutter {
  position: sticky;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
}

.corner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding-inline-end: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.dayHead {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-1);
  border: 0;
  border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.weekday {
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xs);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: var(--vl-letter-spacing-overline);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.dayNumber {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-width: var(--vl-control-height-md);
  height: var(--vl-control-height-md);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.dayHead[data-today] .weekday {
  color: var(--vl-color-accent-text);
}
.dayHead[data-today] .dayNumber {
  background: var(--vl-color-accent-fill);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-on-accent);
}

.allDay {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
  min-height: var(--vl-control-height-sm);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1);
  border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
}

/* Weekends and today are tinted down the whole column */
.allDay[data-weekend],
.day[data-weekend] {
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-fill) 70%, transparent);
}
.day[data-today] {
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-accent) 4%, transparent);
}

.day {
  border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
}

/*
 * One cell per hour, with a hairline at its end and a fainter one at the half hour (the end of the first slot).
 * Events and the time line live in the cell of the hour where they start: the structure gives the hour, so the
 * CSS only needs the minute and the length, a short and bounded set of rules below.
 */
.hour {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  height: var(--hour);
}

.day .hour {
  border-block-end: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border);
}

.slot {
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.slot:first-child {
  border-block-end: 1px dashed color-mix(in oklab, var(--vl-color-border) 60%, transparent);
}

.hourLabel {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  inset-inline-end: var(--vl-space-2);
  translate: 0 -50%;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xs);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/*
 * Positions without inline styles: data attributes set custom properties, and calc() turns them into lengths.
 * --at is the minute within the hour (data-at in 15-minute steps, data-fine adds 5 or 10), --length the number
 * of quarter hours (data-hours and data-quarters), --lane and --lanes the column among overlapping events.
 */
.calendar [data-at="15"] {
  --at: 15;
}
.calendar [data-at="30"] {
  --at: 30;
}
.calendar [data-at="45"] {
  --at: 45;
}
.calendar [data-fine="5"] {
  --fine: 5;
}
.calendar [data-fine="10"] {
  --fine: 10;
}
.calendar [data-hours="1"] {
  --hours: 1;
}
.calendar [data-hours="2"] {
  --hours: 2;
}
.calendar [data-hours="3"] {
  --hours: 3;
}
.calendar [data-hours="4"] {
  --hours: 4;
}
.calendar [data-hours="5"] {
  --hours: 5;
}
.calendar [data-hours="6"] {
  --hours: 6;
}
.calendar [data-quarters="1"] {
  --quarters: 1;
}
.calendar [data-quarters="2"] {
  --quarters: 2;
}
.calendar [data-quarters="3"] {
  --quarters: 3;
}
.calendar [data-lane="1"] {
  --lane: 1;
}
.calendar [data-lane="2"] {
  --lane: 2;
}
.calendar [data-lanes="2"] {
  --lanes: 2;
}
.calendar [data-lanes="3"] {
  --lanes: 3;
}

.event,
.now,
.nowLabel {
  --top: calc((var(--at, 0) + var(--fine, 0)) * var(--hour) / 60);
}

/* An event: a tint of its calendar, a solid leading edge, and text in the tone moved towards the text color */
.event {
  --length: calc(var(--hours, 0) * 4 + var(--quarters, 0));
  --width: calc(100% - var(--vl-space-2));
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: var(--top);
  inset-inline-start: calc(var(--width) * var(--lane, 0) / var(--lanes, 1));
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: calc(var(--width) / var(--lanes, 1));
  height: calc(var(--length) * var(--hour) / 4 - 1px);
  /* A 15-minute event is still one line of text tall */
  min-height: calc(var(--vl-font-size-xs) * 1.5);

  overflow: hidden;
  border: 0;
  border-inline-start: var(--edge) solid var(--tone);
  border-radius: calc(var(--vl-radius-sm) * 0.75);
  /* A ring of the surface separates overlapping events */
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 16%, var(--vl-color-bg-surface));
  color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 55%, var(--vl-color-text-primary));
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-heading);
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Up to 30 minutes: title and time on one line */
.event[data-short] {
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  padding-block: 0;
}

.event[data-past],
.chip[data-past] {
  border-inline-start-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 45%, var(--vl-color-bg-surface));
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 7%, var(--vl-color-bg-surface));
  color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 35%, var(--vl-color-text-secondary));
}

/* The event whose details are open is solid */
.event[data-selected],
.chip[data-selected] {
  border-inline-start-color: var(--tone);
  background: var(--tone);
  color: var(--tone-on);
}

.eventTitle {
  flex: none;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  /* Words wrap whole; only a word longer than the event is broken */
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
}

/* One line, cut with an ellipsis: in all-day chips, and in events too short for two lines */
.chip .eventTitle {
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.event[data-short] .eventTitle,
.event[data-lanes] .eventTitle {
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* The time stays on one line too: cut with an ellipsis instead of leaving half a line at the bottom */
.eventTime {
  flex: none;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* An all-day chip; a chip of several days loses its rounded ends where it continues in the next column */
.chip {
  display: flex;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: calc(var(--vl-space-1) / 2) var(--vl-space-2);
  border: 0;
  border-inline-start: var(--edge) solid var(--tone);
  border-radius: calc(var(--vl-radius-sm) * 0.75);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 16%, var(--vl-color-bg-surface));
  color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tone) 55%, var(--vl-color-text-primary));
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.chip[data-continues-before] {
  margin-inline-start: calc(var(--vl-space-1) * -1 - 1px);
  border-inline-start-width: 0;
  border-start-start-radius: 0;
  border-end-start-radius: 0;
}
.chip[data-continues-after] {
  margin-inline-end: calc(var(--vl-space-1) * -1);
  border-start-end-radius: 0;
  border-end-end-radius: 0;
}

/* The current time: a line across today with a dot at its start, and the time in the gutter */
.now {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: var(--top);
  inset-inline: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  border-block-start: calc(var(--vl-border-width) * 2) solid var(--vl-color-danger);
  translate: 0 -50%;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.now::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: 50%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: var(--vl-space-2);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-danger);
  translate: -50% calc(-50% - var(--vl-border-width));
}

.nowLabel {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: var(--top);
  inset-inline-end: var(--vl-space-1);
  z-index: 1;
  padding: 0 var(--vl-space-1);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-danger);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-on-accent);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xs);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  translate: 0 -50%;
}

/* —— Overlays —— */

.details {
  width: calc(var(--vl-grid-column-md) + var(--vl-space-6));
}

.detailsHead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
}

.detailsHead .swatch {
  margin-block-start: var(--vl-space-1);
}

/* Day, start and end on one row of the form; the day alone for an all-day event */
.when {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
}
.when[data-all-day] {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
```
